non_operative_declaration: DRY-RUN EXAMPLE — NOT A RECORD OF ANY OPERATION. No upload, publication, activation or rollback has occurred. This document exists to define the shape a future authorized operation would record.
decision_references: no publication authorization exists for token_dictionary@2.0

signing.gap: Contract 1.0.0 defines no receipt or manifest signing. This repository holds no signing key, no key custody procedure and no verification path, and invents none: an unsigned receipt is a statement by whoever wrote the file, and a home-made signature would look like assurance without being any. Establishing a trust mechanism is new infrastructure and needs its own decision.

verified_after_upload.method: A real upload is verified by re-reading the stored object and re-deriving sha256 and byte_count from the bytes actually returned. An ETag, a Content-Length or a success status is not verification: none of them is the content.

note: Upload is a separate, explicitly authorized operation that does not exist in this repository. The origin is null because no destination has been decided and writing one would make a proposal look like a plan of record.
